title: #254 Big or Small Company
prompt: Some graduates are willing to work for big companies rather than small ones. What are the advantages and disadvantages of working at big companies?

promptSegments.text: Some graduates are willing to work for big companies rather than small ones.
What are the advantages and disadvantages of working at big companies?

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.
